name: Lean
desc: This spin: turn 1 of your segments (from your largest other type) into a type you choose.

name: Pinch
desc: This spin: remove 1 enemy segment (wheel min 8).

name: Peek
desc: Reveal 3 fogged enemy segments for the rest of the fight.

name: Scrub
desc: Remove one hazard from your wheel.

name: Taunt
desc: This spin: enemy gains 2 segments of a type you choose. Set up your counters.

name: Double Down
desc: If this spin ties, the Pot triples instead of doubling.

name: Bedrock
desc: Gain Armor equal to your Rock segment count.

name: Landslide
desc: Your next Rock win this fight rolls an extra die.

name: Amend
desc: This spin: convert 1 enemy segment to a type you choose.

name: Footnote
desc: Ink 3 on the enemy. Each Ink makes your next enemy-targeting skill free.

name: Snip
desc: This spin: turn one of your plain segments into an Edge (crit on win).

name: Kindle
desc: This spin: convert 2 enemy segments into Paper (fuel for Flame and Scissors).

name: Swell
desc: Gain 3 Flow (heal at end of turn, decaying).

name: Riptide
desc: This spin: rotate every enemy type one step (Rock>Paper>Scissors>Flame>Tide>Rock).

name: Quake
desc: Your next Rock win also hits every enemy in a pack, and rolls +1 die.

name: Clause
desc: Permanent: in 2 turns, all enemy segments of one type become another type for the rest of the fight.

name: Redact
desc: This spin: delete 2 enemy segments of your choice (wheel min 8).
